timecoded_text_to_speech.text: You're hiking adventure to Mount Hoffman begins in the Osemady Valley when you go out
Highway 120 towards Taioga Road. As your approach snow flat take the turn off to
Meal Lake. You will find a parking area in the trail head to Meal Lake. Meal Lake is a
beautiful stopping point along the way for your trip. A mirror 1.2 miles and you arrive at the
high Sierra Camp at Meal Lake and excellent place to stay overnight.
From Meal Lake you begin your trek to Mount Hoffman a six mile hike.
The trail begins with a walk through a meadow but soon the trail becomes steep and rocky
but the view from Mount Hoffman is worth the trip.
From the top of Mount Hoffman nearly 11,000 feet, you're graced with a fantastic anorama
of Yousemady and the surrounding area.

youtube_description:
Yosemite hiking is a very personal experience! There is always a new trail to explore.  But many hikers have a short stay in the park and like a quick day hike in the sierras.  Hiking is king here!.They also like hikes without a backpack to slow them down.  One of these hikes is to Mount Hoffmann. 

Mount Hoffmann is a peak in the center of Yosemite National Park. It rises above May Lake  to a altitude of  10,855 ft . Many hikers day hike the  6 miles, each way ( 12.6 miles round trip) from Hwy 120 .The mountain is named after the cartographer Charles F. Hoffmann, who was part of the California Geological Survey of the Sierra Nevada .He helped explore the Sierra Nevada of California, from 1860 through 1870, and 1873 through 1874

May Lake is a lake in Yosemite National Park high country There is  also a High Sierra Camp where backpackers can stay in tent cabins located near the lake. There is a  1.2 mile hike to May Lake is from a parking area off east Hwy 120. 

This video was provided by Pine Arbor Retreat
http://www.pinearbor.com
